episode_definition: A continuous true run of the unchanged close signal. A false close re-arms. At most one successful buy per symbol per episode; failed or slot-blocked buys do not consume the episode. Warm-up episodes are retained. Not proof of a distinct physical pullback.
unchanged_rules: Same v1 stock pool, dates, ranks, position sizes, time_7 exit, stops, cooldown, costs, taxes and fills. No parameter search, regime changes or winner promotion.
evidence_scope: Same previously seen history; retrospective single-change diagnostic, not prospective OOS. Zero complete walk-forward windows remains a limitation.
selection_policy: Retain both policies and both costs on both markets, including blocked cases. Primary metrics remain the independently reproduced original baseline, never the best result.
